text: Interfacial passivation reduces non-radiative recombination losses in perovskite solar cells.
title: Interfacial passivation for nonradiative recombination loss in perovskite solar cells
abstract: Perovskite solar cells have reached certified efficiencies above 26%. Interfacial passivation reduces non-radiative recombination losses and raises the open-circuit voltage. Long-term stability remains limited by ion migration.
